Chhattisgarh's Formation Story and Naming Origins

The creation of Chhattisgarh as a separate state from Madhya Pradesh involved a long-standing demand that spanned several years and presented various challenges. The naming of Chhattisgarh is linked to its history, with origins tracing from the Bhoreamdeo temple to the Danteshwari temple, and encompassing dynasties from the Pandu dynasty to the Kalchuri dynasty.
